subject: Orion Labs - throughput SLOs, tier match and credit bridge
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <procurement@orionlabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Ramirez <cto@orionlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated throughput / commercial match request

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Diego and I appreciated the throughput examples and the routing fallbacks you showed. We are finalizing the vendor shortlist for our inference backbone and need to close pricing/terms this month.

Quick context: we run latency-sensitive QA inference (peak bursts up to ~120k tokens/minute, median sustained ~18k tokens/minute). A key procurement ask is a committed reserved pool with a 95th pct latency SLO and a firm unit price that matches or beats a competing incumbent (they've offered an effective committed discount + migration credit).

Attached is our updated RFP and a usage snapshot. Two asks for you:
- Can Redwood provide a written matching/comparability offer (structure + one-time credits) we can take to procurement?
- Can you outline the dedicated pool sizing and the SLO language you would be willing to commit to for an 18–24 month reserved term?

We are hopeful Redwood can be competitive on a) committed unit economics and b) a short-term migration credit to offset our incumbent contract. If you can loop in pricing/finance and get back with a proposal by Friday 10/16 that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Procurement, Orion Labs
procurement@orionlabs.com

Attachments: Orion_RFP_v3.pdf, orion_usage_snapshot_oct.csv

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <procurement@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated throughput / commercial match request

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask and the usage snapshot. I'm attaching a short "credit bridge" outline that describes a migration credit + committed pricing options and an initial pool-sizing recommendation based on the numbers you sent. High level:
- Sizing: a dedicated pool sized for your peaks would be approximated as an 8 x A100-equivalent pool (we can refine after a 48-hour traffic capture).
- Throughput/SLO: we typically guarantee 95th pct token latency under 200–250ms for interactive workloads at committed throughput levels; we can draft SLO language aligned to your traffic shape.
- Commercial structure under consideration: one-time migration credit (applied in first billing cycle) + tiered committed rate with volume breakpoints; stronger credits for longer (24 month) commits.

I will coordinate with Marcus/Ben on what concession range we can present for a market-match ask. Priyom and I will also propose a short mutual action plan so procurement has a clear path to signature.

Target: I'll send a formal proposal + term sheet by Friday 10/16.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
Attached: redwood_credit_bridge_outline.pdf

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 09:13 AM Claire Bennett <procurement@orionlabs.com> wrote:
> (original message attached)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orion Labs - credit bridge ask (need approval for concession band)

Folks — forwarding Orion's ask. Summary and recommendation:
- Account: Orion Labs (strategic, pre-revenue product line)
- Requested: competitor match (effective committed discount) + migration credit to move off incumbent
- Proposed commercial anchor (for procurement review):
  * Option A (18 mo): 12% committed discount + 2-month migration credit (applied as a usage credit)
  * Option B (24 mo): 18% committed discount + 3-month migration credit + annual price lock
- Conditions: signed committed throughput schedule, minimum monthly committed spend of $150k equivalent, and a market-match clause that allows procurement to provide incumbent pricing evidence.

Asking for finance/exec approval of the concession band (up to 18% + 3mo credit) and approval to include a one-time onboarding support credit (services hours) to sweeten the deal. Please advise if we need an exec greenlight or if we can sign under delegated authority.

Priyom
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orion Labs - credit bridge ask (need approval for concession band)

Thanks — a few things I need before we entertain the upper band:
1) Expected ARR lift and NPV model for both Option A and B (show margin impact).
2) Estimated incremental capacity cost (GPU-hours) vs committed revenue for the sizing above.
3) Precedent risk: who else has asked for similar credits and what's the current policy?

Counterproposal (finance-preferred):
- Offer: 10% committed discount + 2-month migration credit + 1 week of onboarding services (remote).
- Term: 18 months minimum; require a buyout clause (remaining commit payable prorated) if they terminate early.

If Sales wants to go to 18%/3mo, need VP sign-off with clear margin model and exec rationale (strategic account / competitive win).

Ben Carter
Director, Finance — Commercial
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <procurement@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: pool sizing, SLOs and refined commercial offer

Claire —

Thanks for your patience while we ran this internally. Based on your usage snapshot and the internal review, here's a concise proposal you can take to procurement:

Technical & Sizing
- Initial dedicated pool: 8 x A100-equivalent nodes (can burst via autoscaling policy up to +35% for seasonal peaks).
- Measurement: committed throughput defined by monthly token quota; we will supply a 48-hour traffic capture to finalize sizing.
- SLO (draft): 95th percentile token latency <= 225ms at or below committed throughput; remediation: credits applied if monthly 95th exceeds SLO more than 2x in a quarter.

Commercial (refined)
- Offer (sales-approved): 12% committed discount + 2-month migration credit applied as bill credits (Option A: 18-mo commit).
- If Orion provides incumbent pricing evidence that exceeds X% delta, we will escalate to a competitive match review (requires VP approval).
- Conditions: signed committed throughput schedule, minimum monthly committed spend $150k, standard buyout clause.

Next steps
1) I'll upload a short term-sheet to DocuSign for your procurement team to review (link included below).
2) If you accept the technical SLO outline, we'll schedule the 48-hour traffic capture and a short onboarding plan.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/details/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-987324

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to run through the SLA language before procurement.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_credit_bridge_outline.pdf

From: Claire Bennett <procurement@orionlabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Ramirez <cto@orionlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: pool sizing, SLOs and refined commercial offer

Ava —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the SLO language. Procurement will review with legal next week. Two quick asks before we circulate:
1) Please include a short market-match clause in the DocuSign term sheet that defines the evidence required from us (redacted competitor invoice + effective committed unit rate) and an escalation path if a match is requested.
2) Can you confirm the start date of the 2-month migration credit (billing month 1 vs. applied on first invoice) so we can model cashflow?

If you include that language I can route the package to Legal + Finance and aim to return a signed redline in 3–4 business days.

Appreciate the speed.

Claire Bennett
Head of Procurement, Orion Labs
procurement@orionlabs.com

(Attachment: Orion_RFP_v3.pdf)
